[[Rahti's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Rahti, Flower of Dread]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Zehlon Reach]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +7
:[[Chaos damage]]: 7-10 (Requires 4 [[Illusion Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +25

==Skin== 
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Greater Istani Staff]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create a [[perfect]] technical version of this item with:
*One of the following [[Illusion Magic]] [[staves]]:
**[[Destroyer Staff]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Staff]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Staff]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]] OR [[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following [[Illusion Magic]] [[staves]]:
**[[Illusory Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Mesmeric Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]] OR [[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Hale and Hearty]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
*The [[Illusion Magic]] version of the [[Deldrimor Staff (unique)]] and [[The Mindstealer]] are [[perfect]] counterparts to this item with more of a focus on maximum health.
*The [[Illusion Magic]] version of the [[Staff of the Forgotten (unique)]] and [[The Mindclouder]] are [[perfect]] counterparts to this item with more of a focus on maximum energy.
